name: change-request
description: Analyze a requested change against approved baselines and produce a controlled change proposal.
---

# Change Request

Analyze the requested change against approved requirements, design, architecture, contracts and QE plan. State reason, alternatives, impacted IDs/files, migration/compatibility, test changes, costs, risks and rollback. Update proposed docs/ADR only if documentation edits are authorized. Do not implement until the user approves the change request and affected baselines.
